preset.name: ios-clang-arm64-simulator
preset.comment: iOS ARM64 (simulator on Apple Silicon) clang PhysX SDK settings - no snippets

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_BUILDSNIPPETS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Disable snippets (GLUT not available on iOS)

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path relative to PhysX SDK root

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES
cmakeParam.comment: Target ARM64 architecture (iOS simulator on Apple Silicon)

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
cmakeParam.comment: Minimum iOS version (iOS 14.0+ for ARM64 simulator)

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_VALID_ARCHS
cmakeParam.comment: Valid architectures for iOS ARM64 simulator
